# logos wasm back-edge stride keeps a call-free loop from starving peers
# a lost yield hangs the node run until the test timeout: the timeout
# is the failure signal, so only the fixed markers are asserted
[!exec:node] skip 'node not in PATH'

env GOPROXY=off
env GOTOOLCHAIN=local
env GOOS=wasip1
env GOARCH=wasm

logos build -o $WORK/exe.wasm .
exec node run.mjs $WORK/exe.wasm
stdout '^peer-ran$'
stdout '^done$'

-- go.mod --
module example.com/loopyield

go 1.27

-- main.go --
package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"runtime"
)

var done bool

//go:noinline
func spin(c chan int) {
	acc := 0
	for i := 0; !done; i++ {
		if acc == -1 {
			done = true
		}
		acc = acc*3 + i
	}
	c <- acc
}

func main() {
	c := make(chan int, 1)
	go spin(c)
	runtime.Gosched()
	done = true
	fmt.Println("peer-ran")
	v := <-c
	fmt.Println(v & 1023)
	fmt.Println("done")
}

-- run.mjs --
import { readFileSync } from 'node:fs';
import { WASI } from 'node:wasi';

const wasi = new WASI({ version: 'preview1', args: [], env: {}, returnOnExit: true });
const mod = await WebAssembly.compile(readFileSync(process.argv[2]));
const inst = await WebAssembly.instantiate(mod, wasi.getImportObject());
process.exitCode = wasi.start(inst);
